scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@aet/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aet/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aet/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@aet/contracts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json --experimental-test-module-mocks --test apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/web/tests/*.test.ts apps/web/tests/*.test.tsx scripts/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@aet/contracts && npm run sync:routes && node scripts/with-env.mjs npm run build --workspace=@aet/web && npm run verify:export
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@aet/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@aet/api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
